title: Fleet Home Delivery Fee Computation for Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
The fleet home delivery fee on a **Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement** under Kessler's **Vehicle Purchase Agreements** is figured from the deal's recorded one-way delivery distance.

## Clause

1. **Chargeable delivery miles.** The chargeable delivery miles are the miles of the recorded one-way delivery distance beyond the deal type's free home-delivery radius.
2. **Delivery mileage charge.** The delivery mileage charge is the chargeable delivery miles multiplied by the deal type's home delivery per-mile rate.
3. **Fleet home delivery fee.** The fleet home delivery fee is the delivery mileage charge rounded to the cent, half up.
4. **Free deliveries.** A fleet delivery whose distance does not exceed the deal type's free home-delivery radius is free, and its fleet home delivery fee is 0.00.
5. **Combination and rounding.** Where an amount is added to the delivery mileage charge and shares apply to the fee, the addition is made first. Each share then multiplies that sum in turn, and rounding to the cent comes last.
6. **Excess reversed.** The excess reversed is the home delivery fee posted on the deal, less any part of it already reversed, less the fleet home delivery fee.


## The quantities

| Quantity | What it is |
|---|---|
| Recorded one-way delivery distance | The miles recorded on the deal for the drive to the delivery address |
| Chargeable delivery miles | That distance less the free home-delivery radius |
| Delivery mileage charge | Chargeable delivery miles multiplied by the per-mile rate |
| Fleet home delivery fee | Delivery mileage charge, rounded to the cent half up; 0.00 when the distance is within the free radius |
| Excess reversed | Fee posted, less any part already reversed, less the fleet home delivery fee |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

These figures are chosen only to show the arithmetic. They are not schedule values.

Take a hypothetical deal type with a free radius of 100 miles and a per-mile rate of 2.10. A fleet unit is delivered 263 miles from the store.

- Chargeable delivery miles: 263 less 100, which is 163 miles.
- Delivery mileage charge: 163 miles multiplied by 2.10, which is 342.30.
- Fleet home delivery fee: 342.30 rounded to the cent, which is 342.30.
- The deal shows a home delivery fee posted at 401.75, with nothing reversed so far. The excess reversed is 401.75 less 0.00 less 342.30, which is 59.45.

Under the same hypothetical deal type, a unit delivered 96 miles out is within the free radius, so its fleet home delivery fee is 0.00. A unit delivered exactly 100 miles out is also free, because its distance does not exceed the radius.
